scope: Exploratory diagnosis of frozen predictions. No model training, cutoff optimization, or molecular computation.

analysis_policy.raw_auc: Higher confidence / lower energy are favorable. Higher H-bond count and length are descriptive orientations, not universal binding rules. Full-cohort AUC is not held-out learned performance.
analysis_policy.bootstrap: 1000 family-cluster resamples of fixed rows, seed42. Percentile intervals describe sampling of these families, not training uncertainty.
analysis_policy.matched: Transfer predictions sliced into the exact within-EGFR test folds; both AUC and AP averaged using fold sample counts.
analysis_policy.budgets: Exploratory prespecified 10% and 20% capacity per saved EGFR test fold. Take ceil(fraction*n); include the whole tied-score block at the boundary. Never use labels to choose cutoffs.
analysis_policy.provenance: Original inputs, labels, family assignments and results remain byte-identical.
